credit_line: Gift of Juan and Anna Marie Hamilton
description: White metal lamp that can be moved up and down/left and right. There are four springs on main body of lamp that are silver in color. Sticker on interior lampshade reads "Underwriters' Laboratories, Inc. ® Listed Portable Lamp Issue No. 79, 684". Another small sticker just above lamp base reads, "Union Made: International Brotherhood of Electrical Workers; Reg. U.S. Patent Off. F47207664". Blue diamond sticker on other side that reads, "Luxo Lamp".
dimensions: 18 in H x 29 in L x 8 1/4 in Diam
title: Lamp
